title: Bug 636971: [Expense Agent] EA Scheduler Task table grows unbounded with no cleanup or UI visibility
summary: The Expense Agent now calls an existing cleanup function so that the EA Scheduler Task table no longer grows without limit.
key_points: Adds a call to an existing cleanup function in the Expense Agent integration code
Stops EA Scheduler Task records from piling up indefinitely
Small change across the EA Agent Dispatcher and EA Agent Scheduler codeunits
quote: Added Call to existing cleanup function.
